name: coreutils
description: The Coreutils package contains the basic utility programs needed by every operating system.

installed_descriptions.description: Is an actual command, /usr/bin/[; it is a synonym for the test command

installed_descriptions.name: base32
installed_descriptions.description: Encodes and decodes data according to the base32 specification (RFC 4648)

installed_descriptions.name: base64
installed_descriptions.description: Encodes and decodes data according to the base64 specification (RFC 4648)

installed_descriptions.name: b2sum
installed_descriptions.description: Prints or checks BLAKE2 (512-bit) checksums

installed_descriptions.name: basename
installed_descriptions.description: Strips any path and a given suffix from a file name

installed_descriptions.name: basenc
installed_descriptions.description: Encodes or decodes data using various algorithms

installed_descriptions.name: cat
installed_descriptions.description: Concatenates files to standard output

installed_descriptions.name: chgrp
installed_descriptions.description: Changes the group ownership of files and directories

installed_descriptions.name: chmod
installed_descriptions.description: Changes the permissions of each file to the given mode; the mode can be either a symbolic representation of the changes to be made, or an octal number representing the new permissions

installed_descriptions.name: chown
installed_descriptions.description: Changes the user and/or group ownership of files and directories

installed_descriptions.name: chroot
installed_descriptions.description: Runs a command with the specified directory as the / directory

installed_descriptions.name: cksum
installed_descriptions.description: Prints the Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC) checksum and the byte counts of each specified file

installed_descriptions.name: comm
installed_descriptions.description: Compares two sorted files, outputting in three columns the lines that are unique and the lines that are common

installed_descriptions.name: cp
installed_descriptions.description: Copies files

installed_descriptions.name: csplit
installed_descriptions.description: Splits a given file into several new files, separating them according to given patterns or line numbers, and outputting the byte count of each new file

installed_descriptions.name: cut
installed_descriptions.description: Prints sections of lines, selecting the parts according to given fields or positions

installed_descriptions.name: date
installed_descriptions.description: Displays the current date and time in the given format, or sets the system date and time

installed_descriptions.name: dd
installed_descriptions.description: Copies a file using the given block size and count, while optionally performing conversions on it

installed_descriptions.name: df
installed_descriptions.description: Reports the amount of disk space available (and used) on all mounted file systems, or only on the file systems holding the selected files

installed_descriptions.name: dir
installed_descriptions.description: Lists the contents of each given directory (the same as the ls command)

installed_descriptions.name: dircolors
installed_descriptions.description: Outputs commands to set the LS_COLOR environment variable to change the color scheme used by ls

installed_descriptions.name: dirname
installed_descriptions.description: Extracts the directory portion(s) of the given name(s)

installed_descriptions.name: du
installed_descriptions.description: Reports the amount of disk space used by the current directory, by each of the given directories (including all subdirectories) or by each of the given files

installed_descriptions.name: echo
installed_descriptions.description: Displays the given strings

installed_descriptions.name: env
installed_descriptions.description: Runs a command in a modified environment

installed_descriptions.name: expand
installed_descriptions.description: Converts tabs to spaces

installed_descriptions.name: expr
installed_descriptions.description: Evaluates expressions

installed_descriptions.name: factor
installed_descriptions.description: Prints the prime factors of the specified integers

installed_descriptions.name: false
installed_descriptions.description: Does nothing, unsuccessfully; it always exits with a status code indicating failure

installed_descriptions.name: fmt
installed_descriptions.description: Reformats the paragraphs in the given files

installed_descriptions.name: fold
installed_descriptions.description: Wraps the lines in the given files

installed_descriptions.name: groups
installed_descriptions.description: Reports a user's group memberships

installed_descriptions.name: head
installed_descriptions.description: Prints the first ten lines (or the given number of lines) of each given file

installed_descriptions.name: hostid
installed_descriptions.description: Reports the numeric identifier (in hexadecimal) of the host

installed_descriptions.name: id
installed_descriptions.description: Reports the effective user ID, group ID, and group memberships of the current user or specified user

installed_descriptions.name: install
installed_descriptions.description: Copies files while setting their permission modes and, if possible, their owner and group

installed_descriptions.name: join
installed_descriptions.description: Joins the lines that have identical join fields from two separate files

installed_descriptions.name: link
installed_descriptions.description: Creates a hard link (with the given name) to a file

installed_descriptions.name: ln
installed_descriptions.description: Makes hard links or soft (symbolic) links between files

installed_descriptions.name: logname
installed_descriptions.description: Reports the current user's login name

installed_descriptions.name: ls
installed_descriptions.description: Lists the contents of each given directory

installed_descriptions.name: md5sum
installed_descriptions.description: Reports or checks Message Digest 5 (MD5) checksums

installed_descriptions.name: mkdir
installed_descriptions.description: Creates directories with the given names

installed_descriptions.name: mkfifo
installed_descriptions.description: Creates First-In, First-Outs (FIFOs), "named pipes" in UNIX parlance, with the given names

installed_descriptions.name: mknod
installed_descriptions.description: Creates device nodes with the given names; a device node is a character special file, a block special file, or a FIFO

installed_descriptions.name: mktemp
installed_descriptions.description: Creates temporary files in a secure manner; it is used in scripts

installed_descriptions.name: mv
installed_descriptions.description: Moves or renames files or directories

installed_descriptions.name: nice
installed_descriptions.description: Runs a program with modified scheduling priority

installed_descriptions.name: nl
installed_descriptions.description: Numbers the lines from the given files

installed_descriptions.name: nohup
installed_descriptions.description: Runs a command immune to hangups, with its output redirected to a log file

installed_descriptions.name: nproc
installed_descriptions.description: Prints the number of processing units available to a process

installed_descriptions.name: numfmt
installed_descriptions.description: Converts numbers to or from human-readable strings

installed_descriptions.name: od
installed_descriptions.description: Dumps files in octal and other formats

installed_descriptions.name: paste
installed_descriptions.description: Merges the given files, joining sequentially corresponding lines side by side, separated by tab characters

installed_descriptions.name: pathchk
installed_descriptions.description: Checks if file names are valid or portable

installed_descriptions.name: pinky
installed_descriptions.description: Is a lightweight finger client; it reports some information about the given users

installed_descriptions.name: pr
installed_descriptions.description: Paginates and columnates files for printing

installed_descriptions.name: printenv
installed_descriptions.description: Prints the environment

installed_descriptions.name: printf
installed_descriptions.description: Prints the given arguments according to the given format, much like the C printf function

installed_descriptions.name: ptx
installed_descriptions.description: Produces a permuted index from the contents of the given files, with each keyword in its context

installed_descriptions.name: pwd
installed_descriptions.description: Reports the name of the current working directory

installed_descriptions.name: readlink
installed_descriptions.description: Reports the value of the given symbolic link

installed_descriptions.name: realpath
installed_descriptions.description: Prints the resolved path

installed_descriptions.name: rm
installed_descriptions.description: Removes files or directories

installed_descriptions.name: rmdir
installed_descriptions.description: Removes directories if they are empty

installed_descriptions.name: seq
installed_descriptions.description: Prints a sequence of numbers within a given range and with a given increment

installed_descriptions.name: sha1sum
installed_descriptions.description: Prints or checks 160-bit Secure Hash Algorithm 1 (SHA1) checksums

installed_descriptions.name: sha224sum
installed_descriptions.description: Prints or checks 224-bit Secure Hash Algorithm checksums

installed_descriptions.name: sha256sum
installed_descriptions.description: Prints or checks 256-bit Secure Hash Algorithm checksums

installed_descriptions.name: sha384sum
installed_descriptions.description: Prints or checks 384-bit Secure Hash Algorithm checksums

installed_descriptions.name: sha512sum
installed_descriptions.description: Prints or checks 512-bit Secure Hash Algorithm checksums

installed_descriptions.name: shred
installed_descriptions.description: Overwrites the given files repeatedly with complex patterns, making it difficult to recover the data

installed_descriptions.name: shuf
installed_descriptions.description: Shuffles lines of text

installed_descriptions.name: sleep
installed_descriptions.description: Pauses for the given amount of time

installed_descriptions.name: sort
installed_descriptions.description: Sorts the lines from the given files

installed_descriptions.name: split
installed_descriptions.description: Splits the given file into pieces, by size or by number of lines

installed_descriptions.name: stat
installed_descriptions.description: Displays file or filesystem status

installed_descriptions.name: stdbuf
installed_descriptions.description: Runs commands with altered buffering operations for its standard streams

installed_descriptions.name: stty
installed_descriptions.description: Sets or reports terminal line settings

installed_descriptions.name: sum
installed_descriptions.description: Prints checksum and block counts for each given file

installed_descriptions.name: sync
installed_descriptions.description: Flushes file system buffers; it forces changed blocks to disk and updates the super block

installed_descriptions.name: tac
installed_descriptions.description: Concatenates the given files in reverse

installed_descriptions.name: tail
installed_descriptions.description: Prints the last ten lines (or the given number of lines) of each given file

installed_descriptions.name: tee
installed_descriptions.description: Reads from standard input while writing both to standard output and to the given files

installed_descriptions.name: test
installed_descriptions.description: Compares values and checks file types

installed_descriptions.name: timeout
installed_descriptions.description: Runs a command with a time limit

installed_descriptions.name: touch
installed_descriptions.description: Changes file timestamps, setting the access and modification times of the given files to the current time; files that do not exist are created with zero length

installed_descriptions.name: tr
installed_descriptions.description: Translates, squeezes, and deletes the given characters from standard input

installed_descriptions.name: true
installed_descriptions.description: Does nothing, successfully; it always exits with a status code indicating success

installed_descriptions.name: truncate
installed_descriptions.description: Shrinks or expands a file to the specified size

installed_descriptions.name: tsort
installed_descriptions.description: Performs a topological sort; it writes a completely ordered list according to the partial ordering in a given file

installed_descriptions.name: tty
installed_descriptions.description: Reports the file name of the terminal connected to standard input

installed_descriptions.name: uname
installed_descriptions.description: Reports system information

installed_descriptions.name: unexpand
installed_descriptions.description: Converts spaces to tabs

installed_descriptions.name: uniq
installed_descriptions.description: Discards all but one of successive identical lines

installed_descriptions.name: unlink
installed_descriptions.description: Removes the given file

installed_descriptions.name: users
installed_descriptions.description: Reports the names of the users currently logged on

installed_descriptions.name: vdir
installed_descriptions.description: Is the same as ls -l

installed_descriptions.name: wc
installed_descriptions.description: Reports the number of lines, words, and bytes for each given file, as well as grand totals when more than one file is given

installed_descriptions.name: who
installed_descriptions.description: Reports who is logged on

installed_descriptions.name: whoami
installed_descriptions.description: Reports the user name associated with the current effective user ID

installed_descriptions.name: yes
installed_descriptions.description: Repeatedly outputs y or a given string, until killed

installed_descriptions.name: libstdbuf
installed_descriptions.description: Library used by stdbuf
